messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none. Duplicates must refer to exactly the same real-world thing: different drugs, brand names, ingredients, formulations, doses, or a general category versus one of its members are NOT duplicates.

item: "take with a meal unless your doctor tells you otherwise"
set: ["take with a meal unless your doctor tells you otherwise", "do this unless your doctor tells you otherwise", "take exactly as your doctor tells you to", "take with a meal or immediately after a meal", "do not stop unless doctor tells you to", "take after a meal", "take only if doctor tells you to", "do not stop taking unless doctor tells you to", "take your dose in the morning if your doctor tells you to", "do not take for longer than your doctor tells you to", "take with food or just after a meal", "do not change dose or stop unless doctor tells you to", "take after a meal or a snack", "only take potassium-rich foods if doctor tells you to", "do not use more than one dose in a 24-hour period unless your doctor tells you to", "swallow the pill whole unless told otherwise by doctor or pharmacist"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
